title: Tart Date Jam Crostata
description: A sweet and tangy tart filled with a date and jam filling, perfect for a dessert or snack.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a bowl, mix together the chopped dates and tart jam.
Spread the date and jam mixture evenly over the pastry dough.
Fold the edges of the pastry dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
